Needs changes before merge.

This is a safety-tier review. The change affects operation generation, project migration, and the checks before posting.

The named refusal covers the parameter entry points. The migration notes survive a save and load. The review command supports undo. The process declaration is present. The PR does not change `PROCESS_VERSION`.

Test results

I ran the checks locally in `.claude/worktrees/review-2253`. The trial merge with upstream main `e808c96299ef7e1edb3206d327acc270847a8a18` had no conflicts. I used the current upstream `AGENTS.md` for the law check. No GitHub runner was used.

| Target | Passed | Ignored |
|---|---:|---:|
| app lib | 355 | 1 |
| app climb_direction | 2 | 0 |
| app mcp | 22 | 0 |
| app mcp_order | 3 | 0 |
| app mcp_verify | 3 | 0 |
| app operation_metadata | 5 | 0 |

All selected targets built. These tests had no failures. The UI tests ran from `crates/ui`. The ignored tests were not run.

Clippy passed with `-D warnings` for the app library, binaries, and all 17 listed app integration targets. Clippy also passed for all UI targets.

The combined app/UI all-target clippy check stopped on existing upstream errors in `crates/app/tests/wire_tool.rs:106-107`:

```text
expected Option<WorkMaterial>, found WorkMaterial
missing fields `stepdown` and `stepover` in initializer of CuttingRow
```

That file is identical to upstream main. This agrees with the limit stated in the PR body. The full quick gate was not run.

I repeated two mutations from the PR body:

- Removed the generator refusal in `operation/generate.rs`: `pocket_adaptive_is_refused_at_every_door` failed. Restored the refusal: passed.
- Removed the migration call in `project/apply.rs`: `v63_pocket_adaptive_opens_as_adaptive2d_with_identical_toolpath` failed. Restored the call: passed.

No golden CL, G-code, or snapshot PNG files changed. There were no moved golden lines to check.

Requested changes

1. **Preserve the review requirement on Copy/Paste.** `crates/app/src/commands/operation/create.rs:206` sets the pasted operation's `needs_review` to an empty list. The UI clipboard also carries only the `Operation`, without these notes. I confirmed the result with a temporary local test: load a legacy operation with dropped rest settings, paste it, delete the source, generate the copy, and post. Posting succeeds without `MarkOperationReviewed`. Carry the notes through the clipboard and paste command, or refuse the copy until review. Add a test that keeps posting blocked for the copy. This is a safety blocker.
2. **Compare the migrated path with independent old output.** `crates/app/tests/pocket_no_adaptive.rs:235` creates the comparison operation from `op.params.clone()` after migration. Both paths therefore use the migrated values. A wrong migrated value can affect both paths and still pass this comparison. Record the old Pocket+Adaptive CL output for the legacy fixture. Compare the migrated output with that record. Issue #1517 requires identical CL across migration.
3. **Keep the Adaptive boss-island coverage.** `crates/app/tests/pick_agnostic.rs:405` replaces Adaptive with OffsetRings. This removes the Adaptive checks for equivalent picks and clearance from the boss. Change the helper to exercise `Adaptive2D` for this case. Keep the existing path and clearance assertions in the heavy lane.
4. **Add before/after UI screenshots to the PR body.** `crates/ui/src/egui_app/op_page.rs:354` adds the review banner and button. The PR also changes the strategy list and browser warning. The body has no before/after screenshots. Show these changed states. Store the images only on the fork's images-only `pr-screenshots` branch and link them from the body.

I removed the temporary copy test and restored both mutations. No source changes remain from this review.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Addressed:

1. Copy/Paste carries the review notes through the UI clipboard and paste command. Deleting the source does not remove the posting block. `pasted_legacy_operation_requires_review_after_source_deletion` and `clipboard_keeps_review_notes_after_source_is_deleted` pin this. Empty pasted notes and empty clipboard notes each made their test fail. Both restored tests pass.
2. The migration test compares CL with an independent legacy record. The unchanged generator at `a529c455352d8c2d228e3dd83d0e5d42a91ea9b0` produced `pocket_adaptive_v63.cl`. `v63_pocket_adaptive_opens_as_adaptive2d_with_identical_toolpath` pins this. Halving the migrated feed made the comparison fail. The restored test passes.
3. The heavy boss-island test uses Adaptive2D again. It keeps the equivalent-pick CL and boss-clearance assertions. `a_face_with_an_island_and_its_rim_loop_cut_the_same_bytes_around_the_boss_full` passes in release mode. Replacing Adaptive2D with OffsetRings made its coverage assertion fail. The restored test passes.
4. The PR body links real before/after UI captures. They show the review banner, button, browser warning, and expanded strategy list. Both capture runs passed. The images exist only on the fork's images-only `pr-screenshots` branch, commit `abc9b5c40dfb27a560362a2b97aecb7908f7acc1`.

New head: `eda3df83dfbda517ec7f4b96649acda68cd3c336`.

Validation: targeted app clippy and UI all-target clippy pass with `-D warnings`. The quick gate and combined all-target clippy are RED. Both hit unchanged upstream errors in `crates/app/tests/wire_tool.rs:106-107`: expected `Option<WorkMaterial>` and missing `stepdown`/`stepover`. The gate passed the app library, accessory collision, and adaptive pinch suites. Remaining suites were stopped after the compile failure and quick-gate budget overrun. They are not reported as passed.

The PR remains a draft. Please re-review this head.
